sentences.text: Wellbore 15/9-F-15 A (Sodir wellbore 5785) on Volve is an observation wellbore with drilling reports from 2008-12-11 to 2009-01-13.
The report span is 34.0 days, with 34 active days, in 1 campaign.
The deepest measured depth is 4095 m with a true vertical depth of 3213 m on the same report, and the Sodir total depth is 4095 m.
Total activity time is 775.5 h, of which primary lost time is 22.5 h, or 2.9 % of the activity time.
Separately, possible lost time is 41.0 h (5.29 % of the activity time); it is not added to the primary figure.

The main outcome: the well was drilled to total depth, data was acquired (VSP and formation pressure points), and it was then plugged back with cement and a new sidetrack was kicked off at the end of the reports. Sodir lists the status as P&A, with an entry date of 2008-12-11 and a completion date of 2009-01-10.
Campaign 1 runs from 2008-12-11 to 2009-01-13, a span of 34.0 days with 34 active days, and its dominant operation phase is drilling.
There is no later completion or workover campaign; the final section of the campaign is plug and abandon work.
Section 1 is a 17.5 in hole drilled from 2008-12-11 to 2008-12-23, from 1381 m to 2591 m measured depth, with a true vertical depth of 2442 m at section end.
It drilled 1210 m of new hole at an average rate of 10.8 m/h while coded drilling -- drill (an average over all time with that code, not an on-bottom rate of penetration).
Section 2 is an 8.5 in hole drilled from 2008-12-24 to 2009-01-07, from 2591 m to 4095 m measured depth, with a true vertical depth of 3213 m at section end.
It drilled 1504 m of new hole at an average rate of 9.4 m/h while coded drilling -- drill (again an average over all time with that code, not an on-bottom rate of penetration).

Section 3 (plug and abandon) has an unknown hole size because the tool gives hole_size_source as unknown; it ran from 2009-01-08 to 2009-01-13, starting and ending at 4095 m measured depth, with a true vertical depth of 3213 m at section end.
Section 3 has no drilling rate: no time is coded drilling -- drill and no new hole was drilled.
Section 1 starts below a casing shoe at 1368.4 m and sets casing with its shoe at 2561.8 m.

sentences.text: The report text that records running this casing reads:
Section 2 starts below the casing shoe at 2561.8 m, and no casing was set in it (the casing shoe is null); the casing prepared in the derrick was never run because the well was plugged back.
Section 3 also starts below the casing shoe at 2561.8 m and set no casing.
Primary lost time by section: section 1 has 4.75 h (1.6 % of its activity time), section 2 has 6.25 h (1.8 %) and section 3 has 11.5 h (8.71 %).

Primary lost time by cause: waiting on weather is 16.25 h over 4 activities, and repair is 6.25 h in 1 activity (the top drive hydraulic valve change); together they make the 22.5 h primary total, 2.9 % of the wellbore activity time.

Possible lost time, kept separate and not added to the primary figures: 12.5 h in section 1 (4.21 % of its activity time), 23.5 h in section 2 (6.78 %) and 5.0 h in section 3 (3.79 %), 41.0 h in total (5.29 % of the wellbore activity time). It is mostly interruption -- other (28.25 h) and interruption -- maintain (12.75 h), which are drilling-rig equipment troubleshooting such as the pipe handling system, elevators, slips and hydraulic hoses.
On 2008-12-13 the rig waited on weather for 4.75 h because winds above the operational limit of the pipe racking system stopped operations (primary lost time).

On 2008-12-20 the casing string could not pass a tight spot near the bottom of the hole and was worked for 8.0 h in two activities, then pulled back, circulation was regained, two joints were laid down and the string was re-run and landed on the following day; these hours were coded as normal casing time, not as lost time.
On 2008-12-31 a casing double slid out of the pipe racking system grip and fell onto the top drive blower hose, costing 2.0 h in two activities (possible lost time).
Also on 2008-12-31 the drilling BHA gave no response in building angle and was pulled to change the BHA.
On 2009-01-07 a hydraulic valve on the top drive was changed out in 6.25 h (primary lost time, repair).
On 2009-01-09 the string tagged an obstruction on the way in for the first cement plug and was plugged; clearing it took 1.5 h in one activity, and the first cement plug was pumped the same day.

Elevator problems (elevators not opening) recurred while pulling out on 2009-01-10, after the last cement plug of the abandonment was pumped that day; this matches the Sodir completion date of 2009-01-10, the end of drilling for the Sodir wellbore.

On 2009-01-11 the rig waited on weather for 11.5 h in three activities because winds of 40 to 50 knots and above stopped the deck crane from moving the BHA, so an alternative method of picking up the BHA from the cantilever was prepared (primary lost time).

The last report date differs from the Sodir completion date because after the plugs were set a new 8.5 in BHA was run, hard cement was drilled and the well was kicked off from the cement on 2009-01-13 to a new sidetrack, which is why reports continue to 2009-01-13.

Weather: waiting on weather was the largest primary lost-time cause at 16.25 h, including 11.5 h on 2009-01-11 when the deck crane could not move the BHA; the next well should have a crane-independent BHA handling plan ready before wind forecasts exceed the crane and pipe racking limits.

Rig equipment: possible lost time of 41.0 h was mostly troubleshooting of the pipe handling system, elevators, slips and hoses, and the one primary repair took 6.25 h on the top drive; the next well should check and spare these items (elevators, pipe racking system, top drive valves) before spud and again before the abandonment trips.

Casing running: the casing was worked through several tight spots and stopped near the bottom on 2008-12-20, so the next well should plan hole conditioning and a wiper trip before running casing, and prepare casing handling equipment (the pick up tool) to avoid stabbing problems.

Handling of casing doubles: the double that fell on 2008-12-31 cost 2.0 h of possible lost time, so the next well should secure racking of casing stands and calibrate the handling system before building stands during drilling.
Directional tools: the BHA gave no response in building angle on 2008-12-31, so the next well should have a backup directional BHA and a clear decision point for when to pull.

Sidetrack from cement: the kick-off from the cement plug took from 2009-01-12 to 2009-01-13, drilling through hard cement, and the plug was only reached after washing through an obstruction, so a plug-back and kick-off should be planned with the abandonment string and BHA ready, avoiding a separate trip and a weather window problem.

row.comments: Waited on weather. Winds > 65 knots, i.e. in excess for PRS operational limit. Meanwhile performed MWD surevy and downlinked powerdrive. Reciprocated on stand from 1841 m to 1801 m MD. Parameters : 3000 lpm / SPP 120 bar / 50 RPM /  torque 9 kNm / ECD 1,43-1,44.
Ran 13 3/8" - P110 - 72# casing from 1035 m to 1359 m MD. Filled every 5th joint with 1,43 sg OBM. Running speed 7-8 jnts/hr.

Worked 13 3/8" csg down from 2572 m to 2577 m MD with circulation of 1500-2300 lpm / 28-35 bar and max 30 MT weight added at approx 1 m/hr. Observed a significant amount of cuttings in return. Up weight 295 MT/ down weight 223 MT.

Worked 13 3/8" csg down from 2577 m to 2579 m MD with circulation of 2300 lpm / 30 bar and max 30 MT weight. Decreasing progress towards 2579 m. Observed rapid pressure increase when  taking weight until 2579 m, where no pressure increase was seen. Unable to pass 2579 m with max 40 MT. Up weight 295 MT/ down weight 223 MT.

Evaluated situation. Made SJA and held tool box talk for recovering 10 3/4" csg double. Secured lower end of csg and attached pick up elevator on top end.

Meanwhile circulated 8 1/2" hole at minimum rate. Parameters : 1100 lpm / SPP 42 bar / 60 RPM / torque 10-12 kNm. Stopped rotation when man-riding to attach pick up elevator.

Made SJA and held tool box talk for recovering 10 3/4" csg double. Secured lower end of csg and attached pick up elevator on top end. Hoisted csg vertical and secured in aft PRS. Inspected TDS blower hose for damage. Ok.

Meanwhile circulated 8 1/2" hole at minimum rate. Parameters : 1100 lpm / SPP 42 bar / 60 RPM / torque 10-12 kNm. Stopped rotation when man-riding to attach pick up elevator.

Drilled 8 1/2" hole from 3142 m to 3180 m in Shetland with 1.32 sg OBM. Drilling parameters : 2150 lpm / SPP 146 bar / 160-200 RPM / torque 14-18 kNm / WOB 9-12 MT / ECD 1.34-1.35 sg EMW / ROP 2-9 m/hr. Stopped pumps to reset BHA tools. Not able to build angle/no response from Xceed. Decided to POOH to change BHA.
Held tool box talk and changed out hydraulic valve on TDS. Secured work platform.
Pumped 9.45m³ 1,90 SG Silica cement slurry at 800 lpm. 50bars, 20 rpm & 14 kNm.

Made up TDS to string and attempted to wash down. Observed pressure rise to 85 bars. Pulled back to 2578m and attempted to circulate. Immediately pressure increased to 44 bars. Monitor for pressured leak off - no pressure drop observed. 
Pulled to 2551m and attempted to circulate. Pressured up to 110bars.
Pulled to 2537m and attempted to circulate. Confirmed string plugged by circulating through TDS and down mud bucket line.
Mixed and pumped 11m³ 2.00 SG Norcem cement slurry at 800 lpm. 50bars, 30 rpm & 12 kNm. Displaced cement lines to rig floor.
Trouble shooted problem with elevators and change out same.
Due to wind at 50 knots + no crane operation. Evaluated picking up BHA with PDM - no go due to lengths and components of tubulars.
Waited on weather. Wind 50 kts plus. Performed general maintenance.
WOW. Wind to high for deck crane to operate. Meanwhile prepared alternative solution to transport BHA to drill floor without using the deck crane. Wind 40-50 knots. Performed PM and house keeping.

Kicked off at 3185m and drilled 8½" hole to 3210m 50/50 cement/formation. Drilling parameters: Flow 2140 lpm / SPP 144 bars / String RPM 130 TQ 12-26 kNm / WOB 2-5 / ECD 1.4 EMW / MUD weight 1.34 SG / ROP 4-6 mph.
